author: Pueblo CO Daily Brief
title: 🐶 Playful & Loving Dogs Ready for Adoption in Pueblo, Colorado - NewsBreak
text:
7 hours ago Pueblo has some wonderful dogs hoping for a fresh start and a cozy home. Here are a few local pups who are ready to meet you.
BULLET Breed: Husky / American Pit Bull Terrier mix Age: Young, male Color: Brown/chocolate with tan Shelter: Humane Society of the Pikes Peak Region - Pueblo Phone: (719) 544-3005 ext.2 Bullet is a handsome young mix with striking coloring and a lot of potential. As a Husky/Pittie blend, he’s likely to be active, smart, and strong, and will do best with someone ready to give him exercise, training, and structure. If you’re looking for a partner for walks, hikes, or playtime in the yard, Bullet could be your guy.
👉 Meet Bullet and apply to adopt on adoptapet
Koda Breed: Plott Hound / Catahoula Leopard Dog mix Age: 5 years old, male Weight: About 70 lbs Color: Brindle Fixed: Neutered Good with: Other dogs (per owner) Adoption Fee: $30 Listed by: For Adoption By Private Owner (Pueblo, CO) Koda is a big, loving boy who enjoys being outside, exploring, playing with toys, and soaking up attention. He especially loves belly rubs and butt scratches . Koda’s owner passed away, and the family is looking for a home where he will be cherished and treated like family. He’ll be a great fit for someone who wants a loyal companion and has time for daily walks and affection.
👉 Meet Koda and apply to adopt on adoptapet
